affected.note: About 1 million ANA Mileage Club members, about 3% of all members. Only romanized names, membership numbers and Star Alliance status were involved. ANA does not use SITA itself; the data came from a SITA system used by another Star Alliance airline.

summary.en: All Nippon Airways announced that data of about 1 million ANA Mileage Club members leaked after unauthorized access to a system of SITA used by another Star Alliance member airline. Romanized names, membership numbers and status tiers were involved.
summary.ja: 全日本空輸は、スターアライアンス加盟の他社が利用するSITA社のシステムへの不正アクセスにより、ANAマイレージクラブ会員約100万人分の情報が漏えいしたと公表した。対象はローマ字氏名、会員番号、ステータスである。
